description: This Java source file defines the class 'VertxBasedHealthCheckServer' which provides an HTTP server for health checks using Vert.x. It manages endpoints for liveness and readiness probes, supports secure and insecure configurations, and allows registration of additional resources and checks.

classes.name: VertxBasedHealthCheckServer
classes.description: A class implementing a health check HTTP server using Vert.x, supporting secure/insecure endpoints, registration of health checks, and additional resources.

methods.name: VertxBasedHealthCheckServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server with Vert.x instance and configuration.

methods.name: registerHealthCheckResources
methods.description: Registers liveness and readiness health checks from a provided service instance.

methods.name: setAdditionalResources
methods.description: Sets additional resource handlers to be registered during server startup.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the secure and insecure health check HTTP servers.

methods.name: bindInsecureHttpServer
methods.description: Binds the insecure HTTP server if configured.

methods.name: bindSecureHttpServer
methods.description: Binds the secure HTTP server if configured with SSL.

methods.name: registerAdditionalResources
methods.description: Registers additional resource handlers on the router.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the HTTP servers.

methods.name: getInsecurePort
methods.description: Returns the port of the insecure HTTP server.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port of the secure HTTP server.
